# Himanshu Prajapati

> AI Infrastructure Engineer — LLM inference and serving, GPU provisioning, and agentic systems.

Early-career AI infrastructure engineer focused on the LLM inference stack. Open-source contributor to llm-d, vLLM (GuideLLM), and SkyPilot. Building tinyserve, a from-scratch LLM serving engine with continuous batching and a paged KV cache. Deployed Llama 3.1 via vLLM + KServe on Kubernetes. Competitive programmer, 500+ problems solved.

## Projects

- tinyserve: https://github.com/himanshu1573/tinyserve — readable LLM serving engine on an 8 GB M1: continuous batching, hand-written paged KV cache, OpenAI-compatible API (Python, MLX, FastAPI, asyncio)
- Kubeflow Docs Assistant: https://github.com/himanshu1573/docs-agent — agentic RAG over Kubeflow docs: Kubeflow Pipelines ingestion, Milvus, Llama 3.1-8B via KServe + vLLM; 91% Precision@3
- Drug Discovery Agent: https://github.com/himanshu1573/Drug-disovery-multiple-agent — LangGraph multi-agent target prioritisation over MCP connectors to DepMap, Open Targets, Pharos, Europe PMC

## Open Source

- llm-d: merged Go changes in llm-d-inference-sim (tool-call argument generator, tokenizer sidecar startup gating), llm-d-router (EPP streaming usage), llm-d-benchmark (namespace cleanup)
- vLLM GuideLLM: merged Python changes to the multi-process benchmark scheduler (demand-gated request pulling, worker-0 attribution)
- SkyPilot: Kubernetes GPU-variant scheduling, Nebius InfiniBand on Blackwell, managed-jobs cleanup, Slurm SSH hooks, multi-cloud staging buckets
